newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet races higher with NYMEX, diffs stable.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet races higher with NYMEX, diffs stable.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices raced 1.5 cents higher tracking NYMEX futures late Thursday, while differentials held stable at elevated levels from a week-long rally.
U.S. Gulf aviation-quality 54-grade fuel was offered at 2.0 cents over February futures, steady with Wednesday, while New York material was offered at about 5.0 cents over.

"End users today didn't have to confront a lot of refiner buying," one relieved Gulf player said, noting that diffs had firmed a full 1.5 cents on Wednesday as Koch, Texaco, Conoco and others sought barrels.
((- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632))
